title: Omnia
description: This project adds a massive, carefully curated 350+ mod experience. Omnia combines next-gen aesthetics (Distant Horizons, Shaders), deep farming/building mechanics, and epic exploration into one uncompromising, hardware-hungry sandbox.
body:
![Banner of Modpack Omnia](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2dc374609e66a247b0c302e4cf8736a50e02fa0.jpeg)
# Welcome to Omnia!

**Brought to you by Biotic Studios**

Omnia is not just a modpack – it’s a complete, uncompromising overhaul of the Minecraft experience. We combined breathtaking next-gen aesthetics with deep farming mechanics and massive exploration. Whether you want to build the ultimate cozy homestead or push your high-end hardware to its absolute limits, Omnia has everything you need.


## ⚡ FEATURES

✔️ 350+ Hand-Picked Mods – A massive, yet perfectly balanced and curated experience.

✔️ Next-Gen Visuals – Pre-configured with stunning Shaders and Distant Horizons support. Time to make those high-end Nvidia and AMD cards sweat!

✔️ The Ultimate Homestead – Features the complete Let's Do series for deep farming, baking, and cozy building.

✔️ Overhauled World Generation – Experience breathtaking new landscapes (Terralith) and fully revamped dimensions.

✔️ Epic Exploration – Hundreds of new dungeons, structures, and hidden secrets to discover.

✔️ Total Quality of Life – Includes Waystones, expanded storage systems, and Xaero's Minimap with custom features.

✔️ Optimized Performance – Heavily tweaked with modern performance mods (Fabric) for smooth gameplay despite the massive content.

✔️ Multiplayer Ready – Perfectly balanced for SMPs and long server sessions with friends.

NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT
